name: Jester’s Bane + Steinsopp // Free Live
description:
Jester’s Bane is an underground stoner folk rock trio from the east side of Oslo — heavy in sound, light in spirit, and slightly questionable in judgment. With Kiki Maze on vocals, guitar and general noise pollution, Mathias Eriksson on uncompromising bassism, and Arunas Mazeika behind the drums, Jester’s Bane forge a charmingly heavy and gloriously wonky sound - like a party that nobody quite remembered to leave.

Norwegian heavy psychers Steinsopp play their own blend of groovy, spaced out stoner riff galore on behalf of the interdimensional mushroom society. For fans of Sleep, Dead Meadow and Black Sabbath.
